content.value: Card: dataset used to train GPT4All-J and GPT4All-J-LoRA; versions v1.0 (original), v1.1-breezy (instances of 'AI language model' removed), v1.2-jazzy (also 'I'm sorry, I can't answer...' removed), v1.3-groovy (v1.2 with ShareGPT and Dolly added, ~8% semantic duplicates removed). Metadata lists 808,812 examples. The card does not say how the responses were generated, so no model-parent edge is recorded.
